definitions.explanation: Fish native to tropical regions, often kept as aquarium pets due to their colorful appearance. Also refers to such fish in their natural habitat.

examples.japanese: {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw colorful tropical fish at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Temperature control is important for a tropical fish tank.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧ (tropics) + {魚|ぎょ} (fish). Refers to colorful fish from tropical regions, commonly kept as aquarium pets.

- {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep tropical fish
- {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧: tropical fish tank

CULTURAL NOTE:
Keeping {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ} is a popular hobby. Home centers and pet shops often have dedicated sections. Popular species include グッピー (guppies), ネオンテトラ (neon tetras), and エンゼルフィッシュ (angelfish).
